action.new_text:
def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Input validation
    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or logp_with_result.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("logp_with_result must be a 2D numpy array")
    if logp_with_result.shape[0] == 0 or logp_with_result.shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("All three input matrices must have the same shape")
    if not np.isfinite(logp_with_result).all() or not np.isfinite(logp_call_only).all() or not np.isfinite(logp_no_call).all():
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must contain only finite values")
    if (logp_with_result > 0).any() or (logp_call_only > 0).any() or (logp_no_call > 0).any():
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not np.isscalar(tau_filter) or not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative scalar, not a boolean")

    # Compute normalized future-token weights
    H = logp_with_result.shape[1]
    t = np.arange(H)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = raw_weights.sum()
    norm_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum if weight_sum > 0 else np.ones(H) / H

    # Compute weighted future-token loss: -sum(w * logp)
    L_no_call = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_with_result = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)

    # Margin and keep
    margin = L_minus - L_with_result
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
